about: Buildings measured by hand. Each replaces any Ordnance Survey outline it overlaps. Parts are rectangles in metres in a local grid: origin (E, N) on the British National Grid, u along `bearing` (degrees clockwise from grid north), w at right angles to the left of u. Heights are metres above the ground: `eaves` where the roof starts, `top` the ridge. Roof types: gable (ridge runs `along` u or w), lean (falls towards the `low` side: u0, u1, w0 or w1), hip. `door` is the side the main door faces (n = +w, s = -w, e = +u, w = -u). Materials: see MATERIALS in js/buildings.js. `details` record what was seen of a building (matched by the point `at`, lat/lon, inside its outline): wall/roof/groundWall/plinth materials, `front` (compass side facing the road, letter or degrees), `doors` and `chimneys` as fractions 0..1 left to right as seen from the front (chimneys along the main ridge), `windows` [ground, upper] counts on the front, `storeys`, `label`. `roads` entries with `osm` (an OpenStreetMap way id) set `sidewalk` (both/left/right/no, sides relative to the way's direction) where OSM has no sidewalk tag. `lidarBuildings` are garages and sheds that the Ordnance Survey outlines miss: each `at` point picks a building-shaped blob of the LIDAR, confirmed on an aerial photograph, which tools/fit_buildings.py measures like any other building.

buildings.name: Old Hall Cottage
buildings.label: Old Hall Cottage
buildings.notes: Grade II, early 19th-century estate cottage. Two storeys of red brick under a hipped pantile roof with a central stack, single-storey lean-to wings either side. The front (to Newark Road) has two white sashes per floor and blind recesses in the middle, and no door.
buildings.sources: Historic England listing (via Wikipedia); EA LIDAR 2022 last return and intensity; Street View from Newark Road, checked 2026-10-15

buildings.name: Rendered house and brick range, Newark Road
buildings.notes: Two-storey house in weathered cream render with a brick stack at its north-west end, joined to a long single-storey red-brick range along the road (blank wall, small door) and a rear wing; pantiles throughout.
buildings.sources: EA LIDAR 2022 (fit_buildings.py parts); NLP intensity (pantile); Street View from Newark Road, checked 2026-10-15
